name: Gloves of Missile Snaring

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: A Reaction cuts the damage of a ranged weapon hit by 1d10 + Dex; cut to 0 and you catch the missile.
text: These gloves seem to fuse with your hands once you pull them on. When you're struck by a ranged weapon attack while wearing them and have a free hand, you can use your Reaction to lower the damage by 1d10 + your Dexterity modifier. Should the damage drop to 0, you can snatch the missile out of the air, as long as it fits in that hand.
